source.title: 2026 UDK Expert List: Values
source.author: Fantasy Footballers
source.summary: Fourteen players whose cost trails their projected role or ceiling.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A double-digit-round price already accounts for touchdown regression in the league's highest-total offense.
takeaways.rationale: A double-digit-round price already accounts for touchdown regression in the league's highest-total offense.
risks: His MVP-level touchdown rate is unlikely to repeat.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Consistent touchdown production, some rushing floor and early high-total matchups make Purdy an overlooked QB2.
takeaways.rationale: Consistent touchdown production, some rushing floor and early high-total matchups make Purdy an overlooked QB2.
risks: His weekly ceiling can depend on game environment.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Reliable volume, heavy red-zone passing and a career-long top-12 track record make Prescott a strong late backstop.
takeaways.rationale: Reliable volume, heavy red-zone passing and a career-long top-12 track record make Prescott a strong late backstop.
risks: He offers less rushing upside than elite options.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A league-leading win projection and durable touchdown role make Henry attractive at a discounted second-round cost.
takeaways.rationale: A league-leading win projection and durable touchdown role make Henry attractive at a discounted second-round cost.
risks: Age and workload decline remain unavoidable risks.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A new extension and almost no backfield competition support another 300-opportunity RB1 season.
takeaways.rationale: A new extension and almost no backfield competition support another 300-opportunity RB1 season.
risks: Last season's touchdown total can regress.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A likely three-down and goal-line role creates top-10 upside at an injury-discounted RB2 price.
takeaways.rationale: A likely three-down and goal-line role creates top-10 upside at an injury-discounted RB2 price.
risks: He is returning from a major leg injury.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Career highs behind a strong line and no major new competition provide a stable RB2 floor.
takeaways.rationale: Career highs behind a strong line and no major new competition provide a stable RB2 floor.
risks: Kyle Monangai will retain a complementary role.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Denver re-signed Dobbins to lead carries behind an elite line, making his late starter price attractive.
takeaways.rationale: Denver re-signed Dobbins to lead carries behind an elite line, making his late starter price attractive.
risks: RJ Harvey can command passing-down work.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: His every-down X role and strong two-receiver usage preserve rebound upside at a WR3 price.
takeaways.rationale: His every-down X role and strong two-receiver usage preserve rebound upside at a WR3 price.
risks: Jacksonville's crowded receiver room creates weekly uncertainty.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Mike Evans' departure leaves Egbuka positioned for a lead role and a possible Year 2 top-12 finish.
takeaways.rationale: Mike Evans' departure leaves Egbuka positioned for a lead role and a possible Year 2 top-12 finish.
risks: His late-2025 efficiency collapse cannot be ignored.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: Denver paid premium capital for Waddle, whose route efficiency and screen fit create easy-volume upside.
takeaways.rationale: Denver paid premium capital for Waddle, whose route efficiency and screen fit create easy-volume upside.
risks: Courtland Sutton and Denver's spread offense compete for volume.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A healthy Jayden Daniels and shootout-friendly schedule make McLaurin's one-round discount attractive.
takeaways.rationale: A healthy Jayden Daniels and shootout-friendly schedule make McLaurin's one-round discount attractive.
risks: Stefon Diggs adds legitimate target competition.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A 16% target share and expanded two-tight-end usage make Strange a cheap late streamer with growth potential.
takeaways.rationale: A 16% target share and expanded two-tight-end usage make Strange a cheap late streamer with growth potential.
risks: He has not yet established a weekly fantasy floor.

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A reduced price restores access to LaPorta's double-digit-touchdown ceiling in an elite offense.
takeaways.rationale: A reduced price restores access to LaPorta's double-digit-touchdown ceiling in an elite offense.
risks: A crowded target tree and recent injuries add volatility.
